Teodor is named all over this page, but he is the cutscene partner and the minigame opponent, not a standing entity you walk up to -- every interaction, including retrying after a loss, is with Masad. Targeting Teodor would have been the classic pattern-match error here.

TWO RUNGS, NOT EIGHT. Bullet 1 is the cutscene. Bullet 2 is the Boom or Bust minigame you must actually beat (three rounds). Bullet 3 -- talk to Masad twice in a row after a loss -- is how you re-enter that same rung, so it merges into it rather than becoming a rung of its own. Bullets 4 through 8 are the RULES of the minigame (shooting, staying, the three tricks, folding, the bust-over-11 arithmetic): commentary on how to play, not things you go and do. Both rungs sit on the same NPC, so this is one marker either way; the second rung exists because beating the game is a real obstacle between the two cutscenes.

ALTERNATIVE PATH RECORDED BUT NOT MODELLED. The after-the-walkthrough section says that if you hold the key item 'Rhapsody in Azure' you may buy the key item 'Card Jailer Teodor' from a Curio Vendor Moogle for 1,000 gil and skip the minigame entirely, then return to Masad for the final cutscene. It is a genuine OR branch, but both arms begin and end on Masad so the marker is identical on either, and NEITHER key item name resolves against this client's KI table -- resolve.lua returns no id for 'Rhapsody in Azure' or for 'Card Jailer Teodor' under any casing -- so putting either in items_alt would have produced an entry stage C drops. It stays here and in or_branch_unmodelled. The Curio Vendor Moogle is likewise not made a step: the page never says which one or where, and 'Moogle' with no zone is the ambiguous-target shape the validator forbids outright.
